propositions: PASS-path reuse (idempotent_reuse) synthesizes empty blocking/advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying the last review's actual findings from the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar
BLOCK-path reuse (verdict_reuse) already correctly replays stored blocking/advisory/coaching with a reused notation, establishing the desired output shape
CLI notation does not unmistakably state that rendered findings are from the last review replayed (not a fresh LLM run) or include the review's recency anchor

PASS-path reuse must read and replay the stored sidecar's advisory/coaching/indeterminate and coverage.counts when the sidecar matches the material fingerprint, with fail-open degradation to empty lists if sidecar is absent/unreadable/mismatched
Both reuse paths must render notation indicating output is the last review replayed against an unchanged plan, with --force pointer and optional recency anchor (verified_at_sha/reviewed_at)
